subject: Pen test follow-up: logging redaction evidence and monitoring snippets
messages:
From: Maya Lopez <mlopez@finco.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: secops@finco.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test follow-up - evidence of remediation and config snapshots

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for taking the time on the call this morning. As discussed, FinCo's external pen test (summary attached) identified a medium-risk finding around insecure logging of access tokens in debug logs (Finding ID: FINCO-PT-2026-07-3). Our auditors have requested concrete evidence that Redwood implemented the remediation and the compensating controls you described.

Specifically we need: 
- UI screenshots showing the logging-redaction toggle disabled for debug-level logs (or equivalent)
- A redacted export of the logging configuration that shows retention/level settings and token-redaction rules
- Links to Jira tickets or internal traces that show the remediation work (a single ticket id that links to the change set is fine)
- A short note describing compensating controls (KMS rotation cadence, token scope minimization, monitoring/alerting rules) if full remediation is delayed

Can you provide these artifacts by EOD Friday 2026-10-22? If that timeline won't work, please propose the earliest feasible delivery date.

Thanks,
Maya Lopez
Security Operations
FinCo

Attachments: finco-pt-summary-2026-07.pdf (1 file)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maya Lopez <mlopez@finco.com>
Cc: secops@finco.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test follow-up - evidence of remediation and config snapshots

Hi Maya,

We will collect and deliver the artifacts you requested. High-level plan:

1) Monica will pull the UI screenshots and the redacted config export.
2) Karthik will add the remediation Jira ticket(s) and a short controls summary (KMS, retention, alerting).
3) I'll assemble the package and upload to the Drive link you can access, and paste the Jira links in-line.

We aim to have a first bundle to you by EOD 2026-10-21; if anything needs more time we'll call it out by tomorrow morning.

Deliverables (expected): screenshots/logging-redaction-ui.png; config-export-logging-redacted.json; jira-INF-1423.pdf; compensating-controls-overview.txt

Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Note: attachments referenced will be redacted to remove tenant-specific identifiers before sharing.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Maya Lopez <mlopez@finco.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test follow-up - evidence of remediation and config snapshots

Hi Maya,

Attached is the first evidence bundle. Summary below:

1) Screenshots: screenshots/logging-redaction-ui.png - shows the logging redaction control in the Admin Console (timestamp 2026-10-21T09:20:00-07:00). Sensitive fields are overlaid with gray boxes.
2) Config: config-export-logging-redacted.json - exported from the logging daemon; tenant IDs and IPs removed but retention levels, log levels, and redaction rules retained.
3) Jira traces: jira-INF-1423.pdf - contains ticket INF-1423 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1423) with PR, code review, and deployment notes for the logging fixes.
4) Compensating controls summary: compensating-controls-overview.txt - short description: KMS key rotation: 90-day automated rotation, key usage audit enabled; Token scope: minimized default scopes for internal service tokens and short TTLs at the gateway; Monitoring: anomaly alerts on token access patterns and automated revocation workflow (runbook linked).

If you need a non-redacted export we can provide it via a secured S3 presigned link under an NDA; please advise.

— Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: screenshots/logging-redaction-ui.png; config-export-logging-redacted.json; jira-INF-1423.pdf; compensating-controls-overview.txt

From: Maya Lopez <mlopez@finco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, secops@finco.com
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test follow-up - evidence of remediation and config snapshots

Monica / Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. A couple of follow-ups before we mark the finding closed:

1) Can you paste the exact logging config snippet (3-4 lines) showing the redaction rule regex you used (redacted with placeholders is fine, e.g. "token_regex": "REDACTED_REGEX_1")? The auditors want to see how the rule is structured.
2) For the monitoring alerts you mentioned, can we get a permalink to the alert rule or a snippet of the alert thresholds?

If you can provide those two items by EOD tomorrow we should be able to accept the remediation and close FINCO-PT-2026-07-3.

Regards,
Maya Lopez
Security Operations
FinCo
